tools.name: load_guidance_sources
tools.description: Load exact canonical snapshots into this tab. It preserves unsaved drafts and reports version conflicts; it does not save or activate instructions.

tools.name: list_guidance_sources
tools.description: List tab-local source metadata, optionally filtered by title, name, description, or draft text.

tools.name: read_guidance_source
tools.description: Read one tab-local source with its version, draftId, draft, and sections.

tools.name: open_guidance_section
tools.description: Open an existing source and optional section in the visible reading view.

tools.name: update_guidance_draft
tools.description: Replace one tab-local draft after exact version and draftId checks. It never writes the canonical source.

tools.name: get_pending_guidance_changes
tools.description: Read full pending replacements for an explicit user-requested canonical save through the normal authorized source tool.

tools.name: acknowledge_guidance_saved
tools.description: Confirm a save only after the canonical source was written through its normal tool and reread with exact matching content. It marks saved, never active in the current model.

boundary: The seven WebMCP tools act only on this tab. Direct user Save calls the same owner-authorized Context service as MCP; source originals remain read-only. Both paths reread canonical content and compare original version and submitted draftId. Saved does not mean active in the current model.

sourceExtensions.canonical: optional typed Sense/Corpus locator; exact identity must match reread
